polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. Arkema's sheet for KYNAR 710 (R-ARKEMA-KYNAR-710-TDS), a PVDF homopolymer pellet, prints a density of 1.77-1.79 g/cm³ (ISO 1183-1), a water absorption of 0.03 % at equilibrium, immersed, at 23 °C (ISO 62), a glass transition temperature of -40 °C and a melting temperature of 168 °C (ISO 11357) beside the row's 170, p. 2. It prints no 24-hour figure.
